description: This header file defines internal types, classes, and functions for managing Rust project crates within a build system, including serialization, dependency management, and compiler argument extraction.

classes.name: Crate
classes.description: Represents a Rust crate to be serialized into rust-project.json, including its dependencies, configuration, environment variables, and build options.

methods.name: AddConfigItem
methods.description: Adds a configuration item to the crate.

methods.name: AddRustenv
methods.description: Adds an environment variable key-value pair for the crate.

methods.name: AddDependency
methods.description: Adds a dependency to another crate by index and name.

methods.name: SetCompilerArgs
methods.description: Sets the compiler arguments for crate compilation.

methods.name: SetCompilerTarget
methods.description: Sets the target triple for compilation.

methods.name: SetIsProcMacro
methods.description: Marks the crate as a procedural macro with the path to its dynamic library.

methods.name: root
methods.description: Returns the source file representing the root of the crate.

methods.name: extra_include_dirs
methods.description: Returns additional include directories for the crate.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Returns the crate's index in the serialization.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Returns the display label of the crate.

methods.name: edition
methods.description: Returns the Rust edition used by the crate.

methods.name: configs
methods.description: Returns the list of configuration items for the crate.

methods.name: dependencies
methods.description: Returns the list of dependencies for the crate.

methods.name: CompilerArgs
methods.description: Returns the compiler arguments used for crate compilation.

methods.name: CompilerTarget
methods.description: Returns the optional target triple for the crate.

methods.name: proc_macro_path
methods.description: Returns the optional path to the procedural macro dynamic library.

methods.name: rustenv
methods.description: Returns the environment variables for the crate.
